build_graph_transducer: build a graph transducer with start and accept nodes and weighted arcs using gtn.Graph
compose_two_graphs: compose two graph transducers together using gtn.compose to chain input and output symbols
compute_forward_score: compute the forward score of a graph transducer using gtn.forward_score for log-sum-exp over all paths
find_viterbi_path: find the best scoring path through a graph transducer using gtn.viterbi_path and gtn.viterbi_score
union_multiple_graphs: union multiple graph transducers into one using gtn.union to combine alternative languages
